name: Anata, Gomennasai...
source: Mita Yusuke got married and was living a smooth-sailing life with his wife Shizuka and daughter Sayaka. However, their seemingly perfect life gradually becomes distorted and starts to drift apart. His beautiful and elegant wife, adorable daughter, and precious sister... The poison fangs of desire directed at them were approaching closer and closer...
